paragraphs: MTM Health sells non-emergency medical transportation, social determinants of health, and mobile integrated health solutions. The company describes connecting Medicaid and Medicare members to healthcare appointments using technology and automation. Members reach those services by contacting their Medicaid or Medicare health plan for eligibility. Transportation options listed include public transit, gas mileage reimbursement, wheelchair accessible vehicles, and rideshare services, depending on what a health plan allows.

Other services named are home and community based service therapies, and supplemental services such as home therapies, personal care, and home modifications through partnerships with HCBS providers. MTM Link is described as a mobile app and online portal for members to schedule, track, and manage rides. Transportation vendors, volunteers, and independent drivers are invited to join the provider network.

A case study on fraud prevention describes a fraud, waste, and abuse detection process built on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and robotic process automation. That page reports 23,000+ cases of potential fraud flagged and investigated in 2025, with 37% deemed valid. Flagged concerns are reviewed by a Special Investigations Unit before any response.

quote.text: MTM Health connects Medicaid and Medicare members to vital healthcare appointments using technology and automation to improve the transportation experience.
